headline: Zoning requests for projects at 27 Addison St., 81 Western Ave., 22 Keystone Rd., and eight other properties.
summary: A request to change permit conditions for 50R Maplewood Avenue is on the list. New requests include an accessory dwelling unit at 9 King Philip Rd. and an addition at 3 Highland Ct.
items: Consent: Chair to sign decisions for 55 Holly St. and 2 High Rock Ter.
50R Maplewood Avenue: review request to modify comprehensive permit conditions and project plans (Bigelow Real Estate, LLC)
27 Addison St.: convert two-family home to three-family with fewer parking spaces (Lauri Francis)
81 Western Ave.: demolish and rebuild non-conforming structure and increase coverage in AE zone (81 Western Ave. Realty Trust)
9 King Philip Rd.: construct accessory dwelling unit (Derek Moore)
15 Honeysuckle Rd.: construct shed (Agata and Francesco Groppo)
22 Keystone Rd.: construct accessory building and exceed maximum accessory building height (Richard Johnsen)
7 Keystone Rd.: access property other than legal frontage (Mark Hubbard)
3 Highland Ct.: construct addition (David Barry and Allison Muise)
28 Eastern Point Rd.: renovate and construct addition, and modify previous decision (28 Eastern Point LLC)
location: Rose Baker Center for Aging Well, 1st floor, Multipurpose Room, 6 Manual F. Lewis St. Gloucester

## NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING

**CITY OF GLOUCESTER**

**ZONING BOARD OF APPEALS**

**November 12, 2026 Meeting, 7 PM**

**Rose Baker Center for Aging Well**

1st floor, Multipurpose Room

6 Manual F. Lewis St. Gloucester

**\*\*\* REVISED AGENDA\*\*\***

The public is welcome to attend in person.

Zoom link to access the meeting remotely is also available:

**ZBA Meeting: November 12, 2026**

**Join from Computer, Smart Device: https://gloucester-ma-gov.zoom.us/j/82018160493**

**Join via Phone:** +1 (312) 626-6799, Alternate: +1 (929) 205-6099

**Meeting ID: 820 1816 0493**

Please visit http://gloucester-ma.gov/remote-public-meetings for instructions and guidance on how to join a remote meeting.

Please note that the in-person meeting will not be suspended or terminated if technological problems interrupt the remote connection.

Listed items may be heard out of order.

### Consent Agenda:

1. Approval of the Chair to sign the following decisions.
   a. 55 Holly St.
   b. 2 High Rock Ter.

### Continued Applications:

**50R Maplewood Avenue, Map 24, Lot 3** Bigelow Real Estate, LLC, Review request for substantial change to modify comprehensive permit conditions and project plans. 760 CMR 56.05(11)(c)

Application of Lauri Francis seeking a special permit and/ or variance to convert from a two family to a three family with relied of lesser number of parking at **27 Addison St., Map 25, Lot 52** in the R-5 zoning district.

Application of 81 Western Ave. Realty Trust seeking a special permit and/ or variance to demolish and rebuild a non-conforming structure and to increase coverage in an AE zone at **81 Western Ave., Map 3, Lot 34** in the R-5 zoning district.

### New Applications:

Application of Derek Moore seeking a special permit and/ or variance to construct an ADU at **9 King Philip Rd., Map 230, Lot 125** in the R-20 zoning district.

Application of Agata and Francesco Groppo seeking a special permit and/ or variance to construct a shed at **15 Honeysuckle Rd., Map 96, Lot 139** in the R-10 zoning district

Application of Richard Johnsen seeking a special permit and/ or variance to construct an accessory building and exceed maximum accessory building height at **22 Keystone Rd., Map 237, Lot 58** in the R-40 zoning district.

Application of Mark Hubbard seeking a variance to access the property other than the legal frontage at **7 Keystone Rd., Map 237, Lot 112** in the R-10 zone.

Application of David Barry and Allison Muise seeking a special permit and/ or variance to construct an addition at **3 Highland Ct., Map 64, Lot 37** in the R-10 zoning district.

Application of 28 Eastern Point LLC seeking a special permit and/ or variance and to modify a previous decision to renovate and construct an addition at **28 Eastern Point Rd., Map 132, Lot 1** in the R-10 zoning district.

### Discussion by Board:

### Adjournment:

**Joseph Parisi, III, Chairman**

The above agenda items are those reasonably anticipated by the Chair to be discussed at the meeting. Not all items listed may in fact be discussed, items not listed may also be brought up for discussion, to the extent permitted by law.

Please visit the Zoning Board of Appeals page on the City's website to view the above applications and petitions and direct all questions regarding these applications to the office of the Building Inspector during normal business hours at 978-325-5210.

All documents intended to be considered by the Board must be submitted 72 hours prior to the meetings.
